title: Article: Why Homa (Fire Ritual) Works Best

segments.text: Fire (Agni) sends the offering directly to the deity. That’s why homa is the safest and purest way to give bhog — and receive blessings even while you carry the dosh.
Must be done under Guru’s guidance
When done right, you can survive the dosh and even attract luxuries that weren’t written in your destiny.
In Ashaeiynn, Homa (fire rituals) are a powerful part of the journey — and they’re performed regularly to support aspirants in many ways.
Whether someone is struggling with spiritual blockages, family karmas, negative energies, or wants to invite abundance and healing, Homa becomes the key to unlock divine help.
But here’s what makes Ashaeiynn different:
Every day, special Homas are performed to clear negativity, pitra dosh (ancestral karmas), black magic, and even heal the body of aspirants affected by dark energies.
Full Moon Homa – A Special Event
On every full moon, a powerful Homa is conducted with the presence of many divine entities — and that’s when different Sankalps (intentions) can be taken depending on the aspirant’s need:
Jagriti Sankalp – for awakening and upgrading mantra shakti
Pitra/Negativity Sankalp – for clearing deep-rooted karmas and negative influences
Raksha Suraksha Sankalp – for full protection against harmful entities and energies
These Sankalps help focus the energy of the Homa on specific problems — and because the divine presence is much stronger on full moon days, results can come faster and deeper.
So, based on the challenges they’re facing, aspirants choose the right Sankalp — and the Homa helps bring powerful change in their lives.
Because when the fire carries your prayer with the right mantra — the universe listens.
